name: Barboach
description: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Mud Bomb
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user restores its own HP but also becomes drowsy.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.
